meta.name: mp_guard
meta.description: Avatar built from source.png by "rev2d avatar build". Generated: edit avatar.json (or its "post" ops), not this file.

parameters.description: Head turn: + toward the screen right.
The character's left eye (image right): 0 closed, 1 open.
The character's right eye (image left): 0 closed, 1 open.
Body sway: + leans toward the screen right.

warps.description: The whole illustration as one lattice: head turn, tilt, body sway and breath are bindings on it, every layer is its child.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's right eye (image left): closes as EyeROpen goes to 0.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's right eye (image left): closes as EyeROpen goes to 0.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's left eye (image right): closes as EyeLOpen goes to 0.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's left eye (image right): closes as EyeLOpen goes to 0.
The mouth area: MouthOpen moves the skin below the mouth line down, MouthForm moves the corners; nothing moves at the rim of the area.

parts.description: The illustration (moving layers cut out and filled in behind) as one continuous mesh.
Eye-white underlay and mask of the character's right eye (image left): both rows move onto the meeting line of the lids as EyeROpen goes to 0.
Eye-white underlay and mask of the character's left eye (image right): both rows move onto the meeting line of the lids as EyeLOpen goes to 0.
Eyeball of the character's right eye (image left), clipped by eyeR_white.
Eyeball of the character's left eye (image right), clipped by eyeL_white.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's right eye (image left).
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's left eye (image right).
Eye white on the lower lid edge of the character's right eye (image left): fades out as the eye closes.
Eye white on the lower lid edge of the character's left eye (image right): fades out as the eye closes.
Crease, lid shading and eye corners of the character's right eye (image left): static, fades out as the eye closes.
Crease, lid shading and eye corners of the character's left eye (image right): static, fades out as the eye closes.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's right eye (image left).
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's left eye (image right).
Eye white on the upper lid edge of the character's right eye (image left): fades out as the eye closes.
Eye white on the upper lid edge of the character's left eye (image right): fades out as the eye closes.
Drawn closed eye (the eye on the image left), shown while EyeROpen is below about 0.15.
Drawn closed eye (the eye on the image right), shown while EyeLOpen is below about 0.15.
Hair in front of the character's right eye (image left) (an opaque copy, its rim a matte): the lid closes behind it; the hair feature moves it with the hair.
Hair in front of the character's left eye (image right) (an opaque copy, its rim a matte): the lid closes behind it; the hair feature moves it with the hair.
The mouth area of the illustration (an opaque interior patch: it covers the base copy).
Drawn mouth "mouth_a", shown around MouthOpen 1, MouthForm 0 (and wherever it is the nearest drawn shape).

bindings.description: Pseudo-3D head turn: a dome over the face oval plus a wider dome over the whole head; zero outside the head ellipse.
Head tilt: 8.5 degrees about the neck pivot at AngleZ = 30, the angle weighted by the neck band and a fan around the pivot.
Body sway: 2.5 degrees about the body pivot at BodyAngleX = 10, fading out over the body fade band.
Breathing: the chest rises and widens, shoulders and head follow by a third.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's right eye (image left): the lower lid line rises to the meeting line.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's right eye (image left): the lash band travels down to the meeting line.
Lower lid (lower lid line, lower lashes) of the character's left eye (image right): the lower lid line rises to the meeting line.
Upper lid (lash line) of the character's left eye (image right): the lash band travels down to the meeting line.
Mouth shape (MouthForm) on the mouth patch; drawn mouths show the opening.

animations.description: Seamless 8 s idle: two breaths, a slow body sway, a gentle head motion, blinks at uneven times and one glance.
One blink (play it "once" over another animation).
A 2.4 s talking loop: the mouth opens to different degrees, with some mouth form.
A nod: the head dips and comes back.
A calm 7 s loop: the head and the eyes look left, right and up.
For reviews: AngleX, then AngleY, then AngleZ through their whole range (6 s each).
